cues.text: NoGuru is an automated spot-trading bot that selects and reviews coins, buys in stages as prices fall, and targets sales above their average purchase price. Cornix executes its instructions in your exchange account.
You choose the capital. You stay in control. NoGuru handles repeated trading decisions. I help you understand the choices and bring your own judgment to them.
A useful tool can carry something human: the care put into making it, and the curiosity you bring to it. Let’s take it one piece at a time.
You choose the capital. NoGuru reviews many candidate coins and selects several for one maintained strategy, so you do not have to choose every trade yourself.
The work continues after selection. NoGuru reviews the coins and maintains future purchase sizes and price levels as markets change.
Cash leaves room for later purchases. You can explore an intended allocation here, then review the costs and setup when you are ready.
Let’s follow an illustrative cycle. Here is the first purchase: a little capital becomes a holding in one coin.
Price reaches a lower buying level. A second purchase lowers this same cycle’s weighted average cost, while committing more capital.
The target sits above that average. An eligible exit may trail a rise and seek a sale after a retreat. It is an aim, not a guaranteed outcome.
A completed sale releases proceeds for possible reuse. Other cycles may wait. A separate lower cycle has its own average; the older cycle’s cost stays unchanged.
This is the public signal model, before fees, rather than a customer account. Open the record to see its cycles, dates and source for yourself.
Completed profit tells one part of the story. Whole account value also includes cash and holdings still waiting. This feed shows open exposure, but not a complete account balance.
You can inspect the same figures directly or ask me to explain them. Beside the record, the market panel gives separate context for what is happening around the strategy.
Give your guide a name and colour. Next time you return, pick up the story. A familiar companion, with the same clear evidence underneath.
When something catches your interest, open its explanation. The Academy is there for a little more depth, whenever it is useful to you.
Keep your judgment in the loop. Open positions can fall or never recover. There is no strategy stop loss, and pausing new trades does not sell what you already hold.
Your account is still unconnected. We’ll review capital, the separate NoGuru and Cornix subscriptions, and a dedicated exchange setup with withdrawals disabled.
The services have separate trial clocks. Cornix starts with the first created trade, including demo or backtesting. Trying the setup is different from proving future returns.
Start your free trial when you’re ready. I’ll show the steps, what each service includes, and where you can follow the strategy in action.
